rule: คอ divides by what the neck IS versus what it STANDS FOR. Sense 1, the body part, takes the whole physical throat: its anatomy and its diseases, what is worn round it (every collar — the head has no garment sense and a collar is named for the neck it encircles), what is done to it, and every figure drawn on the physical neck — กดคอ to force, ค้ำคอ to oblige, ดักคอ to forestall, คอคอด an isthmus, คอห่าน a plumbing trap. Sense 2, the narrow of a vessel between belly and mouth, takes the one architectural neck, คอระฆัง. Sense 4, the appetite that goes down the throat, takes the taste-and-disposition words: ถูกคอ, แตกคอ, ใจคอ. Sense 3, the crown-shaft of a palm, draws nothing.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: คอ — what the neck is, against what it stands for
notes.text:
Four senses: the body part (1), the narrow of a vessel (2), the crown-shaft of a
palm (3), and the appetite that goes down the throat (4). The rule sorts on
whether the คอ in the compound is a physical neck or a person's taste.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: คอ — what the neck is, against what it stands for
notes.text:
Seventeen are physical, and the group is wider than anatomy: it takes the
diseases (คอตีบ), the things worn round it (ปลอกคอ, and every collar), the things
done to it (หักคอ), and the figures drawn on it — **กดคอ** to force, **ค้ำคอ** to
oblige, **ดักคอ** to forestall someone's words, **คอคอด** an isthmus, **คอห่าน** a
toilet trap.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: คอ — what the neck is, against what it stands for
notes.text:
**Four collars file at 1 and the head has no garment sense.** คอซอง, แผงคอ, คอปาด,
คอเต่า are all the neck OF A SHIRT. Sense 2 is specifically *ส่วนของภาชนะ*, a
vessel, and will not take them. They are named for the neck they encircle, so
they go to the body part — the same call as หน้ากาก at หน้า 1. Worth a sense if
anyone ever revisits this head; I did not invent one.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: คอ — what the neck is, against what it stands for
notes.text:
**คอระฆัง is the argued call.** It is the narrowed part of a chedi joining the
bell to the บัลลังก์ — and sense 2's geometry is exactly that: *คอด* between *ตัว*
and *ปาก*. The element it joins is itself called the bell. Filed at 2, which is
otherwise empty. Say so plainly: this is a reading, not a source.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: คอ — what the neck is, against what it stands for
notes.text:
Sense 4 takes three, and they are a matched set: **ถูกคอ** to share a taste,
**แตกคอ** to fall out when tastes diverge (its gloss names รสนิยม), and **ใจคอ**
the disposition. Sense 3, the palm's crown-shaft, draws nothing.
